findings.title: Cache is not re-checked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: After the fast-path read finds `entryPointAssetsCache == nil` and the goroutine acquires `entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock()`, the cache is never checked again. With two concurrent requests in a non-dev environment, both can observe nil, then serialize on the lock and each call `readWebAssetsFromFile`. The second goroutine performs redundant I/O and, worse, overwrites the cache populated by the first goroutine; if its own read fails, it clobbers a valid cache with nil and reports an error. Re-check `entryPointAssetsCache` while holding the write lock and return the cached value if it has been populated by another goroutine.

findings.title: No regression test for concurrent GetWebAssets calls
findings.body: This PR specifically fixes a data race, but no test exercises concurrent calls to `GetWebAssets`. Without a test that starts multiple goroutines against an uninitialized cache and runs under `-race`, a future regression could reintroduce the race or the missing double-check behavior without being detected.
